baseline_models.focus_anchor: Qawl rasul karim binds utterance, envoy, and trustworthy character in one attribution.
baseline_models.mechanism: An articulated payload is sent forth through an envoy whose praiseworthy character makes delivery credible. The messenger genuinely voices the saying, while rasul keeps that voiced ownership relational rather than self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the audible payload.
Being sent forth makes the speaker a transmission vector.
Praiseworthy nobility and generosity supply the vector's trust condition.

changed_reading.before: It is simply a statement spoken by an honorable messenger.
changed_reading.after: Voiced ownership and transmitted origin coexist: the envoy truly says it because he has been sent with it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Qawl can indicate, rasul can arrive in succession, and karim can image bounty and non-withholding value.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase describes a communication mode as well as a rank: meaningful indication arrives successively and without hoarding, like a yielding bounty. Karim colors the messenger's handling of the word as openhanded, not merely prestigious.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying as indication extends qawl beyond vocal sound.
Succession in batches makes delivery an unfolding yield.
Rain-bearing bounty images communication that nourishes as it arrives.
A valued one from whom precious things are not withheld turns nobility into non-hoarding delivery.

changed_reading.before: Karim is only a status adjective.
changed_reading.after: Karim also describes how the messenger releases the saying: successively, fruitfully, and without withholding value.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The qawl-rasul relation combines an effective word with messenger office, while karim marks worthy standing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The envoy's saying is not neutral reportage. Entrusted office gives the word operative force, while nobility constrains that force as honorable delegation rather than self-arrogated rule.

activation_trace.role: A titled speaker whose word has force activates operative speech.
Messenger and message bind verbal force to entrusted office.
Praiseworthy nobility supplies the ethical limit on delegated force.

changed_reading.after: The envoy's voiced word carries delegated efficacy because office, message, and honorable bearer coincide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath over visible and invisible domains turns qawl into audible evidence at an epistemic boundary. The messenger carries an indication from what sight cannot exhaust into a form hearers can inspect.

activation_trace.role: Indication lets the saying function as evidence.
Being sent forth supplies boundary-crossing movement.
Noble character makes the witness trustworthy.
An apportioned oath frames the adjacent assertion as pledged testimony.
Ocular seeing supplies the visible evidentiary domain.
Heart-insight supplies a live mode where the paired clause denies ocular access.

structural_cues: The focus assertion follows paired oath objects: what is seen and what is not seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, sight, inward insight, and qawl as indication; I supply the arrow that utterance mediates the seen-unseen boundary. Alternatively, the pair only magnifies the oath's scope.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies the speaker of a saying.
changed_reading.after: The verse installs the messenger's saying as inspectable testimony whose audible surface points beyond the visible domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated template keeps qawl constant while subtracting poet and hidden-news specialist as production classes. Repeated fewness relocates failure into audience trust and recollection, making the focus phrase a provenance classification rather than a denial of artistry or unseen reference.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech is the invariant payload.
Messenger and message provide the positive provenance class.
Praiseworthy character distinguishes entrusted transmission.
The first repeated qawl holds speechhood stable while agent class changes.
Poetic composition supplies one rejected production route.
Fewness locates deficit in audience response.
The second qawl confirms that provenance, not speechhood, is disputed.
The hidden-news specialist supplies the other rejected route.
Repeated fewness pairs deficient recollection with deficient trust.

structural_cues: Two coordinated negations repeat qawl plus an agent noun and close with parallel clauses of few response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax, poetry, hidden-news expertise, and fewness; I infer elimination by production route. Alternatively, the clauses only reject two speaker labels.

changed_reading.before: Rasul karim is one flattering speaker label among others.
changed_reading.after: Rasul karim names entrusted delivery as a provenance class distinct from authored verse and acquired hidden reporting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The qawl-qalilan echo activates the focus root's non-dominant q-l-l mapping, especially carrying and rising, just before descent names source movement. The saying descends, the messenger bears it, then raises it into voiced availability.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping's carrying and rising image gives qawl a latent burden-bearing profile.
Being sent forth turns bearing into directed relay.
Nobility qualifies how the burden is borne.
The first nearby q-l-l occurrence reactivates carrying beside qawl.
Repetition keeps the burden-bearing activation live.
Caused descent and delivery supplies the opposite vertical motion.

structural_cues: Qawl is followed twice by qalilan, and the next verse opens with tanzil.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the split mapping, repeated q-l-l, carrying, and descent; I let adjacency back-activate the non-dominant branch. Alternatively, qalilan only means little and contributes nothing to qawl.

changed_reading.before: The saying is principally something the messenger authors or voices.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a descended burden the messenger honorably shoulders and raises into speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Even partial false attribution is followed by seizure, force, severing of the life-artery, and exhaustive absence of intervention. The messenger's vulnerable body becomes the enforcement site of textual integrity; karim is fidelity proven under maximal asymmetry.

activation_trace.role: False attribution names the corruption against which focus qawl is tested.
Messenger and message make integrity a custody relation.
Praiseworthy nobility becomes demonstrated fidelity.
False attribution supplies the counterfactual tampering event.
Partitioning makes even partial insertion relevant.
Capture turns the integrity condition into enforceable custody.
Force and right supply asymmetric enforcement authority.
Severance makes corruption terminate the channel.
The life-artery locates enforcement in embodied dependence.
Exhaustive negation removes every human exception.
An intervening barrier names the unavailable protection.

structural_cues: A conditional tampering clause advances through seizure, severing, and universal failure of intervention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies partial false attribution, capture, force, vital severing, and no barrier; I read their sequence as integrity enforcement. Alternatively, it depicts punishment without a communication-system analogy.

changed_reading.before: Karim asks hearers to trust admirable character.
changed_reading.after: Karim is backed by an embodied non-interpolation guarantee: the bearer cannot profit from altering even part of the saying.

context_deltas.mechanism: The saying enters hearers as a bifurcating operation. For receptive hearers, external reminder reactivates memory and joins self-protection; for resistant hearers, knowing denial and covering are reversed by uncovering exposure and regret.

activation_trace.role: Indication makes qawl an active disclosure surface.
Gentle, deliberate delivery supports retention rather than mere impact.
Rain-like bounty explains the initial generosity of disclosure.
Recall after forgetting names the internal operation initially scarce.
A reminder supplies the external reactivation device.
Putting oneself in protection supplies shelter around receptive memory.
Disclosure to the knower makes resistant reception already visible.
Attributing falsehood supplies the resistant counterclaim.
Removing a cover turns regret into exposure.
Covering supplies the resistant action that uncovering reverses.

structural_cues: Repeated pronouns carry the same referent from reminder for the protected to known denial and hasrah for coverers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, protection, knowing, denial, covering, and uncovering; I infer two reception paths caused or exposed by the dispatched indication. Memory may instead presuppose protection, and hasrah may mean regret without an uncovering mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The saying remains passive whether accepted or rejected.
changed_reading.after: The noble delivery operates differently by reception: mnemonic shelter when admitted, counter-covering exposure when resisted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth as tightly made speech and certainty as settled knowledge add coherence under pressure to the messenger's character. Qawl supplies articulated form; messenger and message keep pace; the weave settles rather than rattles.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies material whose construction can be tested.
A stated essence gives the utterance stable semantic contour.
Matching and keeping pace make bearer and message move without slippage.
Intrinsic excellence makes coherence ethically significant.
Tight weaving in speech supplies an internal integrity test.
Settled knowledge supplies the cognitive result.

structural_cues: The same pronoun returns in an emphatic equation with haqq al-yaqin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies well-woven speech, matching, and settled knowledge; I infer relational coherence as part of authenticity. Alternatively, haqq al-yaqin only asserts truth externally.

changed_reading.before: The messenger's nobility is the main warrant.
changed_reading.after: Character and construction cooperate: the noble bearer matches a tightly integrated utterance whose fit settles knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Final exoneration, naming, lordship, and honor prevent the messenger's karim from becoming praise's terminus. Operative force passes through the envoy, while the close clears false attribution and redirects ultimate honor toward the named source.

activation_trace.role: The effective word supplies delegated force needing final direction.
Messenger and message distinguish honored bearer from endpoint.
Nobility supplies genuine delegated honor.
Exoneration clears the source from tested false attributions.
The name as indication points praise beyond the envoy.
Lordship identifies the authority from which speech derives.
Honor and inviolability establish magnification's destination.

structural_cues: The pericope closes with an imperative after repeated assertions about the same referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exoneration, an indicative name, lordship, and honor; I infer praise routed through rather than into the messenger. Alternatively, the imperative is an independent liturgical close.

changed_reading.before: Rasul karim can sound like an endpoint of authority.
changed_reading.after: The messenger's honor is directional: he voices the saying while routing ultimate authority and magnification beyond himself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates karim's remote rounded-joint branch and is not a lexical gloss. It remains anchored in karim, qawl-rasul, messenger-message matching, and haqq's explicit fit image; render it only as an analogy for non-slipping correspondence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Karim's rounded femoral-head branch meets rasul's matching branch and qawl's stated-contour branch.

activation_trace.role: A stated contour supplies one shaped side of the analogy.
Matching supplies coordinated motion between bearer and saying.
A rounded head seated in a joint supplies the strange material image.
A right fitting its place like joint or vessel activates exact seating.
Settled knowledge is the stability produced by fit.

changed_reading.before: Messenger and message are externally associated.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, message and messenger form an articulated joint: distinct pieces moving together without slippage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses karim's necklace image materially rather than adjectivally. It remains anchored through all three focus roots and is sharpened by partial sayings and tightly woven speech; render it as ordered-integrity analogy, not direct meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Uttered qawl, successive rasul movement, and karim's strung-necklace branch permit an ordered-sequence image.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies discrete verbal units.
Succession supplies order among units.
A necklace of strung elements supplies ordered connection.
Partitioning makes insertion or loss of one segment relevant.
Tight weaving in speech makes disturbed sequence detectable.

changed_reading.before: The saying is an undifferentiated block.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, noble transmission is a strung sequence whose pattern is disturbed by partial interpolation.

strongest_changes: The counterfactual turns noble attribution into an embodied chain-of-custody guarantee against partial interpolation.
Seen/unseen and covering/uncovering cues make qawl active evidence that can remind or expose according to reception.
The q-w-l to q-l-l split, repeated qalilan, and tanzil preserve the messenger-as-burden-bearer outlier.
Haqq and yaqin add close fit and verbal coherence beside character as warrants.
summary.what_was_special: Karim migrated from static honorific into a description of transmission: non-withholding bounty, fidelity under bodily risk, directional honor, and, in contained outliers, fitted or strung integrity. These readings coexist rather than collapse into one gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not settle how far karim qualifies only the messenger versus his manner of carrying qawl.
The burden reading depends on adjacency activating a non-dominant split mapping, while ordinary fewness remains primary.
Remembrance and protection may cause each other in either direction, and cover-uncover may remain material analogy rather than lexical causation.
